column1: # INLINE CONFIDENCE MARKERS.
# Written in a page as   [some text]{.marker}   or bare as   {.marker}
# Each one says something about how much to TRUST the thing next to it. That is
# the whole category, and it is deliberately narrow: these are not highlighters
# and not decoration. A marker that does not change how a reader should weigh a
# fact does not belong in this table.
# ADDING ONE IS A ROW HERE. No code change, no CSS change.
# EVERY USE IS COUNTED IN THE BUILD REPORT, grouped by marker. That is the
# actual point -- a marker nobody can list is just a colour. It means you can
# ask 'what is unconfirmed across this whole site' and get an answer.
# COLUMNS
# marker   the token you type: {.tbc}
# label    shown when used bare, with no text of its own
# shape    HOW IT IS DRAWN. Four options, and this is a closed set on purpose
#          (see below): box · plain · strike · soft
# color    WHAT COLOUR IT IS DRAWN IN. Any theme token from colors.tsv --
#          accent, warn, danger, ink-muted, rule -- or a literal value like
#          #7c9c5a or oklch(72% 0.12 150). Blank inherits the body colour.
# tooltip  hover text. Say what the READER should DO about it.
# ⭐ SHAPE AND COLOUR ARE SEPARATE, and that split is the whole flexibility.
# Shape is structural -- does this thing have a border, is it struck out --
# and there are only four because a reader can distinguish four shapes at a
# glance and cannot distinguish nine. Colour is free. Any shape works with any
# colour, so a boxed green confirmation and a boxed amber warning are the same
# mechanism wearing different paint.
#   box     bordered chip, tinted background. Demands attention.
#   plain   coloured text, no chrome. Present but not shouting.
#   strike  struck through. Superseded, kept findable.
#   soft    italic, prefixed with ~. Approximate rather than doubtful.
# ⚠️ PREFER A TOKEN OVER A HEX. A token follows the theme into light mode and
# into every other site; a hex is frozen where you typed it and will be wrong
# on the scheme you were not looking at. Hex is supported because you asked for
# it and it is genuinely useful for a one-off, not because it is the good path.
marker
tbc
